newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria's Assad goes home after successful surgery.
newsitem.headline: Syria's Assad goes home after successful surgery.

text.p: Syrian President Hafez al-Assad left hospital on Wednesday after successful prostate surgery, a presidential spokesman said.
He said the President would resume his duties in full within the next few days.
No further details of the operation were available. Assad, who has previously had his appendix removed and suffered heart problems, is 66 years old. He has ruled Syria since 1970.

The spokesman added that the Syrian leader received telephone calls from several foreign leaders wishing him a speedy recovery, including King Fahd of Saudi Arabia and Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak.
